name: Lucky
trigger: You roll a 1 on an attack, check or save
description: A natural 1 on your d20 for an attack, ability check or saving throw lets you roll again. The second roll stands, even if it is lower.

name: Tinker
description: Using tinker's tools, 1 hour of work and 10 gp of parts produce a Tiny clockwork gadget (AC 5, 1 hp). After 24 hours it quits, unless you put in 1 hour of upkeep.

Pick a form when you build it: a toy creature that shuffles 5 ft in a random direction each turn of yours, a fire starter that lights candles, torches or campfires (it takes your action to use), or a music box that plays a song. You may have 3 gadgets running. Dismantling one costs your action and returns the parts.

name: Breath Weapon
uses: Refills on short or long rest
description: As your action, blast the area set by your draconic ancestry (damage type, shape and save type). Everyone in it makes the save against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus, taking the full dice on a fail and half on a success.
Once spent, it stays unavailable until you take a short or long rest.

name: Relentless Endurance
trigger: You would drop to 0 hit points but not be killed outright
description: If damage drops you to 0 hit points without killing you outright, you stay up at 1 hit point instead.
It works once; a long rest resets it.

name: Savage Attacks
trigger: You score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack
description: On a critical hit with a melee weapon, add one more roll of that weapon's damage die to the extra critical damage.

name: Black Dragon
description: Acid ancestry. A dragonborn's breath weapon fills a line 5 ft wide and 30 ft long and calls for a Dexterity save. The resistance you gain is to acid damage.
